parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchiveFilecsv as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DataLoadErrorMessage as string (),
	ErrorFile as string (),
	ErrorFilecsv as string (),
	ErrorListRecipients as string (),
	ErrorMessage as string (),
	ErrorPath as string (),

	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),

	Marketcsv as string (),

	QuarantineFile as string (),
	QuarantineFilecsv as string (),

}

source(output(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER,CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE,CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME,CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE,CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING DSS  	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON DSS.CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = CL.CALLLIST_CD  	LEFT OUTER JOIN  		(PDS_CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE CCR  			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE CR ON CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = CR.CALLLISTRULE_IID)  		ON (CL.CALLLIST_IID = CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLIST_IID AND CR.CALLLISTRULE_CD = \'DELPERMSCRUB\')  WHERE CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLISTRULE_IID IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> NonCalllistRecords
NonCalllistRecords derive(CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE_Unicode = toDate(toString(CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE_Unicode = CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME_Unicode = CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE_Unicode = CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode = CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER) ~> NonUnicodetoUnicode
